title: first-commit is live
items: Launch day: first-commit.dev is open, and create-first-commit 1.0.0 is the first stable release of the CLI on npm.
One command takes an empty folder to a first commit: the framework's official setup, the libraries you pick, skills and MCP servers for your agent, and an AGENTS.md written for your stack.
70 official kits to start from (landing pages, web apps, SaaS, APIs, mobile apps, monorepos and extensions), each tested in CI on Linux and macOS.
A shared catalog of 100+ libraries (UI, auth, databases, payments, email, AI, observability, testing and deployment) you can add to any kit from the configurator.
Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf and OpenCode. Free, with no account needed to create a project.
